title: EDG Community Update: Week of November 15th
body:
**Highlights**
- EDG DAO Treasury-funded [Trading Competition on Kucoin Exchange](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1461356199270486022?s=20) is now live!
- [The waitlist is now open for Kabocha](https://www.kabocha.network/), the Kusama parachain from the Edgeware ecosystem.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-nov-14/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [Zien revealed Drop 06](https://twitter.com/joinzien/status/1461675560854245384?s=20) by Ben Elliot.
- Wong Joon Ian and Pet Berisha have updated the Edgeware community with [progress on their EDG community-funded podcast “GMI in Crypto Media”](https://twitter.com/decentpartners/status/1461756953030496259?s=20).
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [Kabocha Technical Steward - Treasury Proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/2515-kabocha-technical-steward-treasury-proposal/)
- Treasury tips to Junte and Edson got closed and disbursed for edgUMA management/github contributions and deployment on Beresheet.
- Treasury tip to Anett got closed and disbursed for contributing artworks as TG Working Groups’ logos.


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meet
